review.rationale: Source-model operator and reference transcription reviewed; no experimental response inference. question: Does the selected two-electrode/two-direction native MEMS protocol admit a locked physical UET discrimination test with the currently verified inputs?

output.quantity: source-model bias enclosure, source harmonic identity and route admission decision
output.unit: dimensionless native source-model coordinates and squared frequencies
output.domain: Declared zero-AC E2 54 V DC source-model branch y in [0,1/4], E1 off; positive local mass/stiffness and no physical measured-response score
output.accuracy: 48 exact rational bisections; root enclosure width <= 2^-50; exact voltage-square and inertial identities; no physical uncertainty threshold invented

model.assumptions: Reference Table S1 decimal values treated as exact source-model inputs for this diagnostic, not exact material constants. Conditional E1-off source configuration; only the explicitly bracketed stable branch is certified.
model.approximation: Local linearization around a configured static state; no experimental driven mean shift reconstructed. Inertia sensitivity favorable in the authors' tested IR configuration is retained, not assumed to supply a physical omission bound.
model.initial_boundary: Static residual on [0,1/4]; bounded monotonicity and positive local stiffness; invalid branch/domain refuses computation without clipping
model.drive_environment: Electrostatic squared voltage and gap factor explicitly distinguished. Published 54 V / 0.5 V cosine-coefficient reference for harmonic algebra; root computation uses AC=0. Pressure/damping/source transfer are not inferred from response fits.
model.parameters: 11 Table S1 model coefficients from hash-verified public supplement; upstream geometry/material adjustment to frequency data is disclosed. No new UET parameter, fit, uncertainty, sweep or response trajectory.

data_policy.holdout_policy: Cites physical publications as protocol/equation/model-parameter sources only; no measured response rows or digitized curves used for inference. Already inspected figures are not blind holdout. Raw comparison records and calibration split remain unadmitted.

observation.source_state: Native mechanical x/y generalized coordinates with bias-dependent equilibrium; neither is identified as Phi
observation.generated_trace: No dissipation trace identified with all state or information; no entropy identity invoked
observation.carrier: No optical propagation computation or measured waveform score in this source-model diagnostic
observation.observer_state: Published directional camera targets differ from generalized coordinate point; mode-profile map, phase/exposure, gain, offsets and uncertainty not admitted
observation.readout: Two directional observations are capability evidence, not calibrated signed modal records. Native normalization equation images exist but the current renderer did not permit sign-off.
observation.backaction: Electrode forcing enters native equations; optical detector interaction not quantified and therefore no physical acceptance or zero-backaction assertion
observation.frame: Native dimensionless mode coordinates only; mass and SI normalization not independently established
observation.time_convention: Dimensionless native time; distinguish voltage, force and mechanical frequencies. No SI timing calibration or RMS-to-peak conversion invented.
observation.product_level: Curated reference metadata plus exact source-model diagnostic, not raw experimental data or reduction

error_budget.unit: dimensionless native source-model coordinates and squared frequencies
error_budget.numerical: Exact rational operations and root width <= 2^-50 on declared branch; interval enclosure rather than floating-point root guess
error_budget.approximation: Local source-model linearization, not experimental prediction. Full driven response, material projection and physical omission bounds remain open.
error_budget.measurement: No measured-response comparison, measurement error or manufacturer specification substituted for run-specific uncertainty
error_budget.systematic: Upstream fitted geometry, modal normalization, source phase/force transfer, detector gains/offsets/exposure and bias-dependent state require independent calibration
error_budget.omissions: Unadmitted physical effects not assigned zero; paper's small inertial sensitivity at its IR setting does not certify every use
error_budget.dependence: No covariance or independence invented; future error propagation must use justified joint sets or conservative bounds
error_budget.acceptance: Only source-model diagnostic identities are checked now. Physical rejection requires predeclared independently calibrated prediction and measurement sets and existing physics gates; no numeric physical threshold available.
